openQuestions.answer: On the host, set in willUpdate, so aria-labelledby from the page resolves and the host-role approach is kept.

openQuestions.answer: No: the bar is the visual; label is the accessible name only. Compose text around it.

openQuestions.question: Indeterminate look?

label.note: Accessible name of the bar, not drawn. Alternatively use aria-label or aria-labelledby on the host.

max.note: The amount that means done. Must be greater than 0.

value.note: Current amount, from 0 to max. Values outside the range are clamped. When absent the bar is indeterminate. An empty value attribute is the same as no value (indeterminate).

determinate.note: The fill width eases to the new value.

indeterminate.note: A segment slides along the track; reduced motion shows a static segment instead.

contract.summary: A horizontal bar that shows how far a task has come, or that it is still working when the amount is not known.

# Plan: Progress (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-progress` with `value`, `max`, `label`, determinate and indeterminate modes. Out of scope: visible percentage text, circular variant, paused/error states.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/progress/Progress.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/progress/progress.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/progress/Progress.scss` -> `Progress.styles.ts` (generated) |
| 4 | `src/components/progress/Progress.ts`, `index.ts` |

## Test plan (test-first)
- Role, name from label, aria-valuemin/max/now; custom max; clamping.
- Fill width follows value/max; indeterminate has no aria-valuenow and animates; reduced motion stops it.
- aria-label and aria-labelledby from the page name the bar; one-time missing-name warning.
- Height, radius and colors from tokens; axe.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
None.

## Open questions (recommendation first)
All three answered with the recommendation: role on the host; no visible text; sliding segment for indeterminate.
